symptom: daemon code defaults and startup scripts are set to 1s interval
new daemon processes still restart with interval=60 and evolution_every=3
root_cause: The installed Windows scheduled watchdog task retained old command-line arguments and kept restarting ensure-factory-daemon.ps1 with stale interval and cadence values.
detection: Inspect Task To Run for explicit -Interval/-EvolutionEvery arguments
resolution: Reinstall the scheduled watchdog task with explicit current arguments
Do not rely on code defaults alone when an external scheduler is installed
